scenarios.description: Age 19: at/above the old under-18 exclusion, below the new under-21 exclusion.
Age 15: under both the old and new threshold.
Age 13, no prior parental consent: at the old under-13 threshold (no_match), below the new under-14 threshold (matched).
Age 10, no prior consent: under both thresholds.
Age 16: over both thresholds regardless of consent.

Age 13 with prior parental consent already given. The rule's own condition (predicate p2) already requires no prior consent, so this fails on the condition itself (no_match) on both sides regardless of the age-threshold edit -- the rule's separately-declared exception for consent being true is, by construction, unreachable here (the same structural pattern found in the mortgage fixture; see scripts/build_mortgage_tier1_fixture.py's EDITS comments).
